title: The Pink Gift Wrapping Station
description: A pink gift wrapping station: holographic star wrapping paper, bow-tree wrapping paper, gold-trim gift bags, a pink tape dispenser, satin ribbon and scalloped gift tags.
intro: Wrapping presents is half the fun if the table looks like this. Two kinds of pink paper, gold-trim gift bags, a tape dispenser that matches and a spool of satin ribbon. Six finds, one Amazon list.

approval.source: Jodie sent the final images in chat and asked for the rest of the system to be finished and scheduled
approval.scope: Publish this Lifestyle article and its supplied images

sections.heading: Start with the paper
paragraphs: A pink holographic star wrapping paper roll catches the light and does half the decorating for you. A pale-pink roll printed with green trees tied in pink bows is the one for the presents under the tree, with a polka-dot reverse side.

sections.heading: Bags, ribbon and tags for the finishing touches
paragraphs: Pale-pink gift bags with gold trim and tissue paper are the shortcut for anything odd-shaped. A spool of light pink satin ribbon and a stack of pink scalloped tags with twine make a plain box look finished.

sections.heading: A tape dispenser that earns its spot
paragraphs: A pink desktop tape dispenser with a weighted base stays put while you tear, and it comes with rolls of clear tape ready to go.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The six finds are the two rolls of wrapping paper, the gift bags, the tape dispenser, the ribbon and the gift tags. The table, tree, window, scissors, cocoa, cookies, kraft presents and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
